calculation_handling.description: Driveways and drive aisles serving visitor parking must be clearly identified. This is a site-marking obligation with no numeric value, and the lot data holds no information about it.
calculation_handling.gaps: No requirement token in the vocabulary covers marking or identification of driveways.

units.disclosure: Visitor parking driveways and drive aisles must be clearly identified; we do not check this against your site.

calculation_handling.description: Visitor parking spaces must be clearly identified and marked. This is a site-marking obligation with no numeric value, and the lot data holds no information about it.
calculation_handling.gaps: No requirement token in the vocabulary covers marking or identification of parking spaces.

units.disclosure: Visitor parking spaces must be clearly identified and marked; we do not check this against your site.

calculation_handling.description: A visitor parking space must meet the parking space dimensions of Section 200.5; those dimensions are keyed in their own units.

200.10.1(1).explanation: Driveways and drive aisles that lead to visitor parking spaces must be clearly identified. We do not check this against your site.

200.10.1(2).explanation: Visitor parking spaces must be clearly identified and marked. We do not check this against your site.

200.10.1(3).explanation: A visitor parking space must meet the same dimensions that Section 200.5 sets for parking spaces.
